description: Add a US stock to the signed-in person's StockMap watchlist: to the list named (made if it is new) or their first list. A stock is on one list at a time, so naming another list moves it.

stock.description: A US stock's symbol (NVDA, BRK.B) or its company name (Nvidia)
stock.title: Stock

watchlist.description: The list's name, made if the person has none by that name; left out, their first list
watchlist.title: Watchlist

name: watch

not_landed.description: True: tonight's run has not landed yet, so this is the previous run
not_landed.title: Not Landed

call.description: The model's call, as the watchlist shows it; None: no call this run
call.title: Call

changed_from.description: The call before last night, when last night changed it
changed_from.title: Changed From

already.description: True: it was on that list already, and nothing changed
already.title: Already

list.description: The list it is on now
list.title: List

moved_from.description: The list it was moved off, if it was on another
moved_from.title: Moved From

not_advice.default: The model's track-recorded read, not financial advice.
not_advice.title: Not Advice

title: Watch a stock
